comment: Golden set (written by Claude, do not edit). Each case: a plain-English description the local model must turn into exactly `spec`, and the spec itself which the builders must turn into a mesh that passes check_mesh.py. Family coordinate conventions are in PLAN.md.

cases.name: plate_50x30x5_2holes
cases.description: A rectangular plate 50 mm long, 30 mm wide and 5 mm thick, with two 5 mm holes on the centreline, each 20 mm from the centre along the length.

cases.name: plate_40x40x3_rounded
cases.description: A square plate 40 by 40 mm, 3 mm thick, with 5 mm rounded corners and no holes.

cases.name: cylinder_20x30_solid
cases.description: A solid cylinder 20 mm in diameter and 30 mm tall.

cases.name: tube_25x20x40
cases.description: A tube 40 mm long with a 25 mm outside diameter and a 20 mm inside diameter.

cases.name: spacer_8x4p2x10
cases.description: A spacer 10 mm long, 8 mm outside diameter, with a 4.2 mm hole through it.

cases.name: washer_12x6p4x1p6
cases.description: A flat washer: 12 mm outside diameter, 6.4 mm inside diameter, 1.6 mm thick.

cases.name: box_60x40x25_open
cases.description: An open-top tray 60 mm long, 40 mm wide and 25 mm tall.

cases.name: bracket_40x40x20x3
cases.description: An L-bracket with two 40 mm legs, 20 mm wide and 3 mm thick, with one 4.5 mm hole in each leg, 25 mm from the corner and centred across the width.
